text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Fan Thanksgiving"—a festival where Umamusume fans gather at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A massive crowd of fans packed in to witness the clash between Super Creek and Tamamo Cross in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up real good, Creek!
You and your partner got a massive weak spot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
As long as that's hangin' over ya,
ya won't be runnin' worth a lick in the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're not scared at all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Even if they call it a weakness~,
I still think we make the best combo."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A lot has happened, but we overcame it all
to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get that.
You two really are the best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"But that "best" part is actually your weakness.
Listen closely."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why do Umamusume run?
Everyone has their own reason. But y'know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing that's the same. That is,
'there's somethin' I wanna get my hands on.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Victory, glory, perfecting one's running. Everyone
is aiming for something. But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You two don't have that! Why? Because
by the time you met, it was already 'over.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Creek is happy pampering someone.
And you're happy being pampered.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
With things like this, ya don't need anything else, right?
Yeah yeah, thanks for the feast, I say!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, look at me...
I'm runnin' with my less-than-fortunate family on my back."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: For my starving little brothers and sisters, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you satisfied folks could run like me!
What we've put on the line is completely different!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an extremely persuasive argument.
There was no way to refute it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, so that's how it was.
In that case, I...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some food for them~.
For your little brothers and sisters.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I'm talkin' about.
Let's just toss that whole part out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Logic aside, wouldn't it piss ya off
if an all-lovey-dovey couple could just do whatever they wanted?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I forgive you, the normie-hating fans won't.
Right, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Lovey-dovey couple, the two of us...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So that's how it was, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Facepalm!* What are you two, an old married couple?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, everyone? Makes ya just wanna
scream, "Go blow up!", don't it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! We're so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The crowd seemed to be largely in favor of Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, when it comes to 'hungry' versus 'lovey-dovey',
'hungry' is way more precious!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no future for two folks who are already satisfied.
Now then, what're ya gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross runs with her family on her shoulders.
Will we be able to find an answer to counter her
before the Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, no!
Oh man, this duo is the best~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I stan both of them so much~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Say what?! There's way more cheering than expected!
Aren't you mad they stole the whole spotlight?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Creek, Creek, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, looks like ya got popularity at least.
But a race ain't gonna go that easy for ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If ya think flirtin' and foolin' around will match
my hunger on the track, you're dead wrong. Brace yerself!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fans in the crowd were split right down the middle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Will she find an answer that surpasses hunger before the Tenno Sho?
